description: Render the project to PNG files at full store resolution (e.g. ios = 1320x2868) and return the absolute output paths plus a small inline preview image of the first slide (or the strip) so you can inspect the result. what: "slides" writes slide-01.png, slide-02.png, …; "strip" writes strip.png (all slides side by side — backgrounds flow continuously across it); "both" writes both. Pass scale (e.g. 0.25) for smaller draft output. language: omit for the base text; a language code (e.g. "es") renders that translation (blank/missing fields fall back to base text); "all" writes per-language subfolders of output_dir — source/ plus one per settings.languages code, same layout as the web app's all-languages ZIP (add languages with set_translations first). Each language renders in its own font override when set (see set_translations font / set_style language), else the global font. Fonts are fetched/registered automatically before rendering. Iterate: render → look at preview → set_style → render again.

changed_only.description: Write only added/changed assets compared with the explicit release baseline

language.description: Omit = base text; a language code = that translation; "all" = per-language subfolders

output_dir.description: Absolute directory for the PNGs (created if missing)

output_height.description: Custom height in whole pixels; required with output_width for custom output (320..8192)

output_id.description: Temporary output override for this render

output_width.description: Custom width in whole pixels; required with output_height for custom output (320..8192)

scale.description: Downscale factor for draft output (default 1 = full store resolution)

target.description: Platform target. Omit = active target; "all" = every settings.targets target.

name: render
title: Render PNGs to disk
